name: @rello-platform/signals
description: Cross-app signal zod schemas + canonical signal-type registry (types/categories/normalizer) + SignalPriority namespace for Rello platform
comment:exports: CJS consumers (CommonJS nurture-goals → Milo Engine, per SPEC §7-B Wave B) require() this package. The build stays single-format ESM ON PURPOSE: a real CJS build would convert the internal `import '@rello-platform/slugs'` (also ESM-only, no `require` condition) into a require() that throws ERR_PACKAGE_PATH_NOT_EXPORTED. Instead we expose the SAME ESM entry under `require`/`default`; Node >=22.12 require(esm) loads it (no top-level await), and once inside the ESM graph every transitive import (slugs) resolves via ESM conditions. All consumers run Node 22 (Milo/Rello engines `>=22 <23`, node:22-alpine). v0.5.1.
